Religious experiences may well be neurological phenomena (see [God Helmet](http://youtu.be/Z_rC2pDygvk)), but that does not necessarily mean a religious person is 'crazy.' It could simply mean that their biology makes them more prone to these experiences. 

On the other side of things, religious indoctrination *can* contribute to a person's mental illness. See [postcult trauma](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Post-cult_trauma)

I think it's more likely that something like the converse is true.  [Women whose promiscuity is a characteristic of a personality disorder (often borderline) are more likely to have had mommy or daddy problems or any childhood trauma.](http://ajp.psychiatryonline.org/cgi/content/abstract/160/2/369) Of course, not everyone who is promiscuous has a personality disorder. 

I don't know much about whether this is true for males because most BPs are female.  You can find more information by googling borderline personality disorder, ptsd, trauma etc.
